title: AI Creative Director
intro: Codex prepares the brief; your selected model writes. The author decides what to keep.
modelPolicy: Uses existing AI settings. Providers never switch automatically.
max_calls: Maximum model calls for this task
budgetPolicy: A conservative local estimate requires configured prices and a supported output limit. Codex cost is unknown. This is not a provider bill.
approveContext: Review and approve this writing context before opening the director
important: I approve the important plot decisions
importantStep: This step requires author approval of a plot decision
reviewPolicy: Uses the existing literary reviewer. Covers the candidate and approved safe context, not all Canon. Reports are never forwarded automatically to Writer.
interveneHelp: Pause affects later scheduling. Stop cancels the current request and retains received text. Save new requirements, then explicitly continue.
instructionExample: Keep the first two paragraphs, then continue as a calm negotiation.
cancelCost: Stopping confirms local request handling. Upstream token charges may already exist. Requests are not retried automatically.
discardLocal: Discard unsaved local inputs? Saved tasks and background requests will remain.
cancelWaiting: Still waiting for the request to end. Local inputs remain available; save again later.
stopBeforeRewrite: Stop the current request before selecting a passage to rewrite.
selectDraft: Select a passage in the candidate draft and enter a new instruction.
saveBeforeContinue: Save edited drafts and requirements before continuing.
newStepInstruction: Continue the scene through concrete consequences of character choices.
briefHelp: Available after saving. Reads the approved safe context without a model call.
actualRequirements: Requirements delivered to the writing model
instructionBoundary: Use the current step; add an explicit condition in the brief if needed.
insufficientInputs: Partial input or not applicable to this step
noStyleEvidence: No confirmed profile supplied. Follow author intent and nearby prose without inventing a style profile.
briefPrivacy: Only approved Writer-view requirements are shown, without hidden reasoning or author secrets.
deferredOutcomes: Outcomes left for later (one per line)
pastReviewHelp: These sentences lack exact support in this input. They may be valid. Use the existing targeted review to investigate.
pastReviewNotError: These are low-certainty pointers, not factual verdicts or automatic edits.
